ValidationRule.description: End date must not precede start and may not exceed start plus 12/24/36 months depending on priority (clamped by MIN/MAX).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT(OR(ISBLANK(Start_Date__c), ISBLANK(End_Date__c))), OR( End_Date__c < Start_Date__c, End_Date__c > ADDMONTHS(Start_Date__c, MIN(36, MAX(12, CASE(TEXT(Priority__c), 'Critical', 12, 'High', 24, 36)))) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: End Date is before Start Date or beyond the allowed horizon for this priority.
